plot_single_episode_trajectory: plot a single episode tip position trajectory from a pickle log file on the xy or xz plane
plot_episode_range_trajectories: plot tip position trajectories for a range of episodes with start and end episode arguments
plot_trajectories_to_file: plot tip position trajectories and save the output figure to a specified file path
plot_trajectory_distance_from_goal: plot the distance of tip positions from the goal across multiple episodes with start and end markers
plot_both_xy_xz_planes: plot tip position trajectories on both xy and xz planes as subplots when no plane is specified
